sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Simple sequencing expressions such as *reggel*, délben, délután and *este* help organise a routine.

items.english: I get up in the morning.
I go to bed in the evening.

sections.content: There’s something almost poetic about lefekszem literally meaning ‘I lay myself down’ — Hungarian doesn’t just say ‘I sleep,’ it walks you through the physical act of lying down first. Small details like this are a nice reminder that vocabulary often encodes more literal imagery than its English translation lets on.
